funders.name: European Commission Creative Europe

criteria.claim: Transnational media collaboration and sector resilience; awards reviewed by independent experts.
Distinct collaboration and intermediary/regranting tracks; preserve editorial independence.

eligibility.claim: 2025 Collaborations call requires at least three partners in three participating countries; historical call, not verified open now.

communication_advice.advice: Present a cross-border newsroom workflow, shared adoption and sector benefit; do not pitch an isolated software build as a ready consortium.

funders.limitations: Purposive 20-award sample: nine 2024-call projects, eight 2023-call projects, and three relevant 2022-call projects. Announcement year differs from call year. Consortium organizations documented; individual project managers and selecting evaluators not disclosed. EC upstream awards to IJ4EU/Journalismfund are not independent replications of their downstream awards.

criteria.claim: Democratic practice, rights, dignity, equitable governance; relationship-based organization support.
Soros Justice has a specific US criminal legal reform remit, not a generic software program.

people.name: Mary Fitzgerald

people.name: Christina Voight; Adam Culbreath
people.role: Senior program manager; senior team manager, Open Society–US

eligibility.claim: Most organization grants originate through direct approaches by OSF; program-specific access must be checked.

funders.limitations: Twenty purposively selected awards across different programs and years, not representative frequency estimates: eight 2024 Justice projects, eight 2016 Hungarian grants, four grantee-disclosed grants. Database failed in web tool. Historical staff titles are not current contact recommendations; selecting staff undisclosed. No inference that an old regional program remains open.

funders.name: ECPMF / Media Freedom Rapid Response
programs: MFRR support; distinguish historical JiR cohorts

criteria.claim: JiR provides temporary safety and recovery for threatened media professionals.
Historical 2020 call emphasizes verified threat related to journalistic work and confidential application.

people.name: Alina Toropova
people.role: JiR Programme Manager; Shelter City Leipzig coordinator

eligibility.claim: Applicant must be an eligible journalist under threat, with references and language/residency conditions; check specific call.

communication_advice.advice: For JiR, communicate verified need for temporary relocation and professional continuity. A software-development request requires a different program, partner or procurement route.

funders.limitations: Twenty publicly named alumni support cases, not 20 software grants. Gallery verifies participation but often not individual year, amount or project deliverable. Names are already publicly disclosed; no deanonymization attempted. This cohort is intentionally a program-type counterexample, not technology comparables. Gallery ordering is not award date or priority.
